subject: MAP: POC environment close plan and technical owners
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@beaconhealth.com>, ops@beaconhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-28T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: MAP: POC environment close plan and technical owners

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the kickoff — good alignment. I attached a single-sheet MAP (see 20261228_MAP_Master.xlsx) with owners and gating criteria. I want to lock the close path so engineering can book the peering and issuing slots. High level: we want a production-like POC with dedicated tenant, API keys scoped to test env, and a VPC peer for low-latency requests.

Summary (owners + due dates):
- Tenant org & admin email (Beacon): due 2027-01-03 — needed to seed org-level configs and SAML if you decide to enable it.
- API keys (Redwood): issuance on 2027-01-04 — Jordan will create scoped API keys once tenant is confirmed.
- IP allowlist (Beacon): provide CIDR(s) and any NAT egress IPs by 2027-01-02. We need this to pre-provision firewall rules.
- VPC peering (coordined): propose 2027-01-05 02:00-04:00 PT maintenance window for the peering handshake and routing sync.

Quick asks for you: please confirm the tenant admin email and the public CIDR(s) you expect to use for peering (or say if you prefer we propose ephemeral ranges). If you want the peering outside that maintenance window, share availability and we’ll try to accommodate.

Attachment: 20261228_MAP_Master.xlsx (owners, acceptance tests, rollback plan).

Thanks — I’m cc-ing Marissa (CS) and Jordan (engineer) to keep timelines tight.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <elena@beaconhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@beaconhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-29T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment close plan and technical owners

Kimberly — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Tenant admin: use infra-admin@beaconhealth.com as the initial admin. We will create a dedicated service account if SAML is required, but infra-admin is easiest to use for now.
2) IPs: our infra team prefers a narrow set of static egress IPs. We can provide two /28 ranges (72.21.32.0/28 and 72.21.48.0/28) by EOD 2027-01-02.
3) Peering schedule: Jan 5 at 02:00 PT is fine, but our ops team asks that peering be reversible within 30 minutes in case of route flaps. Are you able to support a quick rollback plan?
4) Security evidence: our security team will need SOC2 evidence and the VM/host hardening checklist. Can Neha (cc’ed by Kimberly) advise on what to provide?

On the DocuSign side, procurement asked for a short MSA amendment that includes the POC SLA and data handling notes. We’ll route that today.

On the MAP: thanks for owning the master schedule — when you say ‘API keys issuance on Jan 4’ does that mean scoped test keys only, or will those keys have the same throttling profile as the hosted prod keys? We’d prefer conservative throttling for the POC.

— Elena
Elena Morales
CTO, Beacon Health

On Mon, Dec 28, 2026 at 09:15 Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Elena,
> 
> Thanks for the productive kickoff yesterday... [MAP attached]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@beaconhealth.com>, ops@beaconhealth.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-30T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment close plan and technical owners

Elena — Jordan here (engineering). Quick technical notes and what I’ll deliver once tenant/admin is confirmed: 

1) API keys: I will issue scoped test API keys on 2027-01-04 with production-like feature parity but reduced throttle (configurable). We will send key names and minimal rotation instructions.
2) IP allowlist: Redwood will add your two /28s to our allowlist and document expected egress. If you use NAT with fixed egress, share those IPs and we’ll pin them.
3) VPC peering: attached is vpc-peering-template.txt (peering config + routing steps). Our recommended peer subnets: Redwood uses 10.10.0.0/16 in this cluster; propose Beacon peer range 10.40.0.0/18 to avoid overlap. Please confirm.
4) Rollback: we’ll run the peering in two phases — control-plane handshake then route injection. If we see route flaps during the test window we’ll remove the route map and revert within 15 minutes. I’ll be on the call and can trigger rollback.

Attachment: vpc-peering-template.txt (peering pre-checklist, BGP/ROUTE setup stub).

Notes: on SOC2 evidence — Neha, can you confirm the exact artifact list we should expect to share externally? I can tag the MAP with the technical acceptance tests once we land the CIDRs.

-Jordan
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@beaconhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-31T15:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment close plan and technical owners — confirmed dates and next steps

Elena — thanks for the quick replies and the CIDRs. Confirming next steps and mutual commitments so we have a single source of truth before procurement and peering: 

Mutual commitments (final):
- Beacon provides tenant admin (infra-admin@beaconhealth.com) by 2027-01-03 — action: Beacon Ops (ops@beaconhealth.com).
- Beacon provides CIDRs (72.21.32.0/28, 72.21.48.0/28) and confirms 10.40.0.0/18 peer range by 2027-01-02 — action: Beacon Ops.
- Redwood issues scoped API keys (test, reduced throttle) on 2027-01-04 — action: Jordan Blake (jordan@redwood.ai).
- VPC peering scheduled 2027-01-05 02:00-04:00 PT (maintenance window) with rollback plan — action: Jordan / Beacon Ops.
- Security evidence: Neha will share a short SOC2 extracts pack and the hardening checklist by 2027-01-03 — action: Neha Kapoor (neha@redwood.ai).

Procurement & signoff: Elena — I saw your note about the MSA amendment. I’ll have Marissa coordinate with your procurement team to accept the DocuSign link and attach the MAP as an exhibit. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5621. DocuSign envelope will be sent today here: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123.

If no blockers, I’ll mark the MAP 'ready for activation' on Jan 03 and Jordan will kick the API-key issuance Jan 04. Please reply if any timing needs adjustment.

Thanks all — happy new year in advance, and let’s close this out cleanly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (requested artifact list); vpc-peering-template.txt; 20261228_MAP_Master.xlsx
